title: Ravines Airbnb listing rewrite: fact and quality check
text:
# Review packet: Airbnb listing rewrite for The Ravines (Beloit, WI)

Airbnb rules that apply: summary max 500 characters; no links, contact details or book-direct offers; accuracy is scored; AI search (Sept 2026) matches guests' plain-language requests to listing text and ticked amenities. House style: no em or en dashes, plain words, no hype, no invented facts.

## Live listing (the only fact source)
THE RAVINES, LIVE LISTING TEXT AS OF NOV 1 2026 (read from the host editor and the public page)
HEADER: Entire cabin in Beloit, Wisconsin. 12 guests, 5 bedrooms, 6 beds, 3 baths. Guest favorite 5.0 from 102 reviews. Title: The Ravines • Riverfront A-Frame + Cedar Tub/Sauna.
AIRBNB AUTO HIGHLIGHTS: On the Rock River near Beloit: a secluded A-frame on the Rock River, about 10 minutes from downtown Beloit's dining and shops. Hot tub, sauna, and fire table. Attentive host.
PHOTO CAPTIONS (host-written): black A-frame in the woods with hot tub, fire table and barrel sauna steps from the deck; steps lead down through the trees to the private dock on the river; cedar hot tub beside Adirondack chairs and a fire table; barrel sauna with cedar benches, a stove heater and a round window; 47-inch freestanding Japanese stone resin soaking bathtub; living room with leather sofa and big wall TV next to the games.
SLEEPING: Bedrooms 1 to 5 one king bed each; living room 1 sofa bed.

SUMMARY: Perched above the Rock River, The Ravines is a modern A-frame retreat designed for deep rest and reconnection. Floor-to-ceiling windows, warm wood tones, and river views create a calm escape. Unwind in the cedar hot tub or barrel sauna, gather by the fire table, or enjoy the vintage arcade. With 5 king bedrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and a private dock with kayaks (seasonal), this is a peaceful getaway just 90 minutes from Chicago.

YOUR PROPERTY: Step onto your double-deck oasis overlooking the Rock River, where a steaming cedar hot tub, glowing barrel sauna, and fire-table lounge create the ultimate wellness escape. Less than 2 hours from Chicago, this luxury A-frame blends nature, relaxation, and modern comfort into an unforgettable stay.
- Wellness at Its Core: Unwind in the cedar hot tub, refresh in the barrel sauna, or gather by the fire table with sweeping river views.
- Cozy & Spacious: Sleeps up to 12 with 5 king bedrooms + queen sofa, 3 full baths, and open living spaces that invite connection.
- Nature Meets Luxury: Floor-to-ceiling windows bring the outdoors in, while a private dock and 2 tandem kayaks (summer months) connect you directly to the river.
- Winter Ready: Apres-sauna evenings, snow-dusted hot tub soaks, and cozy fires make this retreat just as magical in the colder months.
- Work-Friendly: High-speed Wi-Fi and a dedicated workspace allow you to escape the city without losing connection.
- EV charger on site
Guest Access: Entire home + private deck spaces. Outdoor hot tub, barrel sauna, fire-table lounge. Fully equipped kitchen with Nespresso Vertuo, French press, and pour-over. Vintage arcade machine for nostalgic fun (30,000+ games). River dock with kayaks (available in summer).
Other Things to Note: Pet-Free & Smoke-Free: To keep the home fresh and allergy-friendly. Peaceful Retreat: No parties; we want every guest to enjoy the calm, restorative atmosphere. Safety: A doorbell camera and parking-area camera monitor only exterior spaces. Eco-Conscious: Energy-efficient systems and sustainable design keep your stay guilt-free.
Book Your Escape: Whether you're seeking a wellness weekend, cozy family gathering, or remote-work reset, Outlandia's Rock River Retreat delivers the perfect blend of luxury, tranquility, and nature.

GUEST ACCESS: Guests can use the entire property except for 4 locations: Storage closets: Please do not attempt to enter any of the 3 storage closets, which have key code locks. 2 are located in the basement and 1 is located on the main floor. Shed by the River: For your safety, please do not approach or attempt to enter the abandoned shed by the river.

OTHER DETAILS: Kitchen - We have appliances and utensils for your stay. Please bring your own groceries and including condiments, spices and seasoning. We provide 1 extra kitchen towel roll, a few garbage bags, a few dishwasher pods under the kitchen sink. There is also 1 fire extinguisher in case of emergency. Coffee/Tea Bar - We provide a Nespresso machine with coffee pods for your stay. Please bring your own coffee if you would like to use our pour over or French press coffee makers (we have a grinder if you choose to bring coffee beans). Bathrooms - We provide shampoo, conditioner, body wash and hand soaps in all bathrooms. You will also get an additional 2 rolls of toilet paper in each bathroom for your stay. Each guest will receive 1 set of bath towels - feel free to wash and dry them as needed for your stay. Laundry Room - We provide detergent pods and reusable dryer balls for your stay. Basement TVs - There are 2 TVs downstairs. Each TV has a Roku streaming device that has been set to guest mode for you to use your own login during the stay. Grill - We provide heat resistant gloves and a grill cleaning brush stored in the grill. Wi-Fi password will be provided to you before your arrival and will also be available in the handbook.

NEIGHBORHOOD: Welcome to The Ravines, a serene, rural neighborhood nestled along the Rock River. Our newly built A-frame cabin is located on [road name], surrounded by stunning natural beauty. The area is quiet, offering a perfect retreat for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The peaceful atmosphere allows you to relax and recharge while being immersed in nature. You'll find plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities right at your doorstep, from kayaking and fishing in the Rock River to hiking the nearby nature trails. Despite its rural setting, The Ravines is conveniently located within a short drive to downtown Beloit, where you'll discover local dining, shops, and cultural attractions. It's the ideal location for anyone seeking both tranquility and access to modern amenities. Whether you're looking for a peaceful getaway or an adventure-filled escape, The Ravines has everything you need to make your stay unforgettable.

GETTING AROUND: While The Ravines is a peaceful, rural neighborhood, getting around is simple and convenient with a car. Downtown Beloit is just a short 15-minute drive away, where you'll find plenty of dining options, shopping, and cultural attractions. For your grocery needs, several stores like Piggly Wiggly, Walmart, and Woodman's Market are also within a 10-20 minute drive. Parking is easy and free on-site with space available on the gravel driveway at the cabin. For those flying in, Rock County Airport is a quick 20-minute drive, and O'Hare International Airport is about 90 minutes away. Public transportation is limited in the area, so we recommend having a car to fully explore the surrounding natural beauty and local attractions. The Ravines offers a perfect balance of seclusion while still being accessible to the amenities you need during your stay.

HOUSE RULES (structured): up to 12 overnight guests; no pets; no smoking, includes vaping and e-cigarettes; quiet hours 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM; no events; commercial photography allowed; check-in after 3:00 PM, check-out by 10:00 AM; no early check-ins; lock the front door at checkout by pressing the Yale icon on the keypad.

AMENITIES TICKED (72 in editor, 76 shown publicly incl. location features): Air conditioning, arcade games, backyard (private), baking sheet, barbecue utensils, bathtub, BBQ grill, bed linens, blender, board games, body soap, carbon monoxide alarm, ceiling fan, changing table, children's books and toys (0-2, 2-5), cleaning products, coffee, coffee maker (French press, Nespresso, pour-over), conditioner, cooking basics, crib, dedicated workspace, dining table (8 spaces), dishes and silverware, dishwasher, dryer (in unit), EV charger (Level 2), exercise equipment, fire extinguisher, fire pit, fireplace guards, first aid kit, free parking on premises, free street parking, freezer, game console, gym (private, in building), hair dryer, hammock, hangers, central heating, high chair, hot tub, hot water, hot water kettle, indoor fireplace, iron, kayak, kitchen, long term stays allowed, microwave, outdoor furniture, oven (Thor), pack n play, patio or balcony (private), pool table, private entrance, private living room, refrigerator (Thor), room-darkening shades, sauna (private), shampoo, shower gel, smoke alarm, stove (Thor, gas, 6 burners), sun loungers, toaster, TV (HD, Roku), washer (in unit), waterfront, wifi (237 Mbps), wine glasses. Location: private entrance, waterfront, scenic view: river view. NOT ticked: Essentials.


## Proposed rewrite

### Proposed field: summary
A modern A-frame on the Rock River near Beloit, under 2 hours from Chicago. Sleeps 12 in five king bedrooms plus a queen sofa bed, with 3 full baths. A cedar hot tub, barrel sauna and fire table on the deck over the river. Private dock with 2 tandem kayaks in summer, a vintage arcade, a pool table, 237 Mbps wifi and a Level 2 EV charger. Crib, high chair and kids' toys on hand. Built for families, friend groups and small team retreats.

### Proposed field: space
The Ravines is a modern A-frame above the Rock River, with floor-to-ceiling windows, warm wood and river views from the double deck. Downtown Beloit is about 15 minutes away, and Chicago is under 2 hours.

Outdoors
A cedar hot tub, a barrel sauna with cedar benches, and a fire table with Adirondack chairs, all on the deck over the river. Steps lead down through the trees to a private dock, with 2 tandem kayaks in the summer months. There's also a BBQ grill, a hammock, sun loungers and outdoor furniture.

Inside
An indoor fireplace, a living room with a big wall TV, and a 47-inch freestanding Japanese soaking tub. The kitchen has a Thor 6-burner gas stove, a dishwasher, and a coffee bar with a Nespresso Vertuo, French press, pour-over and a grinder.

Games and fitness
A vintage arcade machine with 30,000+ games, a pool table, a game console, a home gym, and 2 more TVs with Roku downstairs.

Sleeping arrangements
Bedrooms 1 to 5: one king bed each
Living room: queen sofa bed
Sleeps up to 12.

For little ones: a crib, a pack n play, a high chair, a changing table, fireplace guards, and books and toys for ages 0 to 5.

Work: 237 Mbps wifi and a dedicated workspace.

Good for
Families and multigenerational trips, with a king bed in every bedroom.
Friend groups who want a sauna and hot tub weekend on the river.
Small team retreats and remote-work weeks.
Summer paddling and fishing from the dock.
Winter sauna nights and hot tub soaks.

The Ravines is part of Outlandia, a small collection of architect-designed homes in southern Wisconsin.

### Proposed field: access
You have the whole house, the deck, the hot tub, sauna, fire table, gym and games, plus the dock and kayaks (kayaks in summer only).

A few areas are closed to guests: 3 storage closets with keypad locks (2 in the basement, 1 on the main floor) and the old shed by the river. For your safety, please stay away from the shed.

### Proposed field: other
Check-in after 3:00 PM, checkout by 10:00 AM. Keypad entry.
Up to 12 guests. Quiet hours 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
No pets, no smoking or vaping, no parties or events.
Two exterior cameras: a doorbell camera and one over the parking area. Both cover outdoor areas only.
Kitchen: bring your own groceries, condiments and spices. A spare roll of kitchen towels, garbage bags and dishwasher pods are under the sink.
Coffee: Nespresso pods are provided. Bring your own coffee for the French press or pour-over; there's a grinder.
Bathrooms: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand soap, 2 extra rolls of toilet paper per bathroom, and a set of bath towels for each guest.
Laundry: washer and dryer, with detergent pods and dryer balls.
The 2 downstairs TVs have Roku in guest mode, so sign in with your own accounts.
Wifi details come before arrival and are in the house guide.

### Proposed field: neighborhood
A quiet, rural spot along the Rock River outside Beloit, surrounded by trees. Kayak and fish from the dock, or walk the nature trails nearby. Downtown Beloit's restaurants and shops are about 15 minutes away, and groceries (Piggly Wiggly, Walmart, Woodman's Market) are 10 to 20 minutes.

### Proposed field: getting-around
You'll want a car, since public transit is limited. Parking is free on the gravel driveway, and there's a Level 2 EV charger. Downtown Beloit is about 15 minutes, Rock County Airport about 20 minutes, O'Hare about 90 minutes, and Chicago under 2 hours.
